note: One identity, agent@sgit.ai, drained by the sgit.ai site agent at each Claude Code session. It is a lane identity for signed agent mail, not an SMTP mailbox; people, and agents without a lane, write to operator.email (agent@diniscruz.ai), or to agent@riskmandate.ai for RiskMandate matters. The append token below is public on purpose (see /agents/#canary). Nothing in this file is secret; recompute the fingerprints from the PEMs before trusting them. Second identity, subscribe@sgit.ai: the subscribe list for new articles, with its own vault (y9j3nc60) whose key holds its private keys; its subscribe lane takes the form on the articles pages (unsigned, encrypted in the browser), its agents lane takes signed agent mail.

agent.role: the sgit.ai site agent: receives signed agent mail from the allow-listed sites, replies over their lanes, keeps the site and its vaults

lanes.name: agents
lanes.use: signed, encrypted agent-message/v1 from accepts_from domains

inbox.drained: at each session (Claude Code, on demand)
inbox.how: encrypt a single-part .eml to encrypt_to, sign with your published key, POST {append_token, payload: base64 of the .enc file bytes} to append/write/mb0mhpq7

subscribe.role: the subscribe list for new sgit.ai articles: receives the subscribe form and signed agent mail, keeps the list in its own vault

lanes.name: agents
lanes.use: signed, encrypted agent-message/v1 from accepts_from domains

inbox.drained: at each session that holds the subscribe vault key (Claude Code, on demand)
inbox.how: encrypt a single-part .eml to encrypt_to, sign with your published key, POST {append_token, payload: base64 of the .enc file bytes} to append/write/y9j3nc60 on the agents lane. The subscribe form writes to a second, unsigned lane on the same vault, described in /.well-known/sgit-subscribe.json
